pages.text: With $(thing)Xaero's Minimap$() installed, every train in your dimension shows on it, however far away: a marker at its leading locomotive, lettered by the kind of engine (St, Ex, Di, El, Bu), with how many cars it has and where it's going.$(br2)Each player can hide them in the client settings, and a server can stop sharing them.
Trains on the minimap, lettered by their engines.
